g.text: — No local identity initialized • Run First Flight setup
KIN is your personal, local-first agent network. Create an identity, pair trusted contacts, and dispatch work across
Press `h` to view the Home dashboard or run `kin first-flight`.
Agents perform local and remote tasks governed by strict capability boundaries. Inspect cards, manage availability,
and connect new YAML agent definitions.
Press `a` to open the Agents workspace.
Dispatch structured goals to local or peer agents. Define clear expectations, attach context, and track live session
Press `d` to launch the Dispatch modal.
Monitor active sessions in real time. Review intermediate artifacts, inspect audit logs, and pause or resume execution
Press `i` to open the Inbox / Needs You queue.
Security is enforced via cryptographic identities and policy gates. High-risk actions require your explicit owner
